profile.headline: Front End Web Developer / Designer
profile.summary:
Multi-faceted digital specialist accomplished in graphic and user interface design, flash and web development, database administration and technical support. A client-driven key contributor who strives to deliver project results that exceed client expectations - on time and on budget.

Portfolio listed at
http://www.mjbeyondbeta.com

positions.title: Freelance
positions.description:
Clients include:
Antonelli College, Arabesque Dance, LLC, Big Splash Productions, Capital M Consulting, Capstone, Feldlaw, Hilton Hotels, In Group Now, LBP Manufacturing, MMPI, Outdoor Recreational Heritage Fund, ProActive, A Freeman Company, Promo Solutions, Terrace Paper Company

Projects include:
• CMS site construction – Built new sites and imported existing websites into client’s CMS program, including ColdFusion & CSS template construction, content management, quality assurance testing and troubleshooting.
      •Content Management systems include Mura CMS, Wordpress, and Joomla!
• Flash animation - Designed and developed an interactive flash product as a “greening effort” for the
client’s upcoming annual meeting. Created ActionScripting for various functions within the project and added Google Analytics to all objects for client to track audience response.
• Site Development - Developed HTML, CSS and JavaScript coding for new websites across multiple industries
• E-Commerce Web Application Development – Designed and created dynamic, database-driven custom web application to manage attendee information and purchases.
• Graphic Design – Designed logos, site layouts and graphics, developed branding schemes, and print collateral

positions.title: Web Producer
positions.description:
Web Producer at a real estate management and face-to-face marketing and trade show management company, working on a variety of digital projects promoting high-end buildings, products and events across multiple industries including gala events, trade and consumer shows, residential furnishings and design consultation services

Web Site Development
• Built new site templates and imported existing sites into CMS using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and ColdFusion
• Quality Tested all sites deployed into CMS to ensure functionality
• Consulted Creative Department to ensure that site designs matched web branding standards and limitations
• Researched and developed JavaScript expanding navigations, drop-down navigations and dynamic
components within CMS’ custom programming language
• Maintained branding standards across multiple buildings and industries

Flash
• Developed splash animations
• Maintained and updated home page flash animations
• Created several photo galleries to match building and show branding guidelines
marketing

Emarketing
• Hand-coded HTML email templates in accordance with standard email best practices
• Assisted in the development of email standards to increase email readability for BlackBerry email clients
• Consulted third party clients to increase their compliance to template standards and email best practices
• Developed successful email campaigns across multiple buildings and industries

Graphic Design
• Created graphic callouts to highlight various events and promotions
• Created web banner ads to promote buildings, events and services
• Created custom graphics to compliment existing web and email templates

Administration
• Created extensive documentation to train both technical users and end-users how to use CMS program
• Hosted multiple training sessions, both in person and via web conferencing to give new users hands-on training with CMS program

positions.title: Interactive Associate Producer
positions.description:
Interactive Associate Producer at a face-to-face marketing communications company, working on a variety of turn-key digital projects for third-party clients.

Web Site and Web Application Development
• Created UI designs for corporate event web sites and custom applications utilizing client’s brand guidelines
• Tested web sites and custom applications to ensure functionality
• Provided client training and support on web sites and content management systems
• Set-up Google analytics on custom applications to provide a measurement tool for the client
• Loaded and managed client content into CMS and websites

Flash
• Designed and developed application demonstration for client presentations
• Designed and developed online tutorial for global customers
• Researched and created flash book as a sales tool for current and prospective clients

Emarketing
• Hand-coded HTML e-blasts and e-newsletters in accordance with standard email guidelines
• Consulted clients on emarketing best practices

Project Management
• Participated in project team meetings from projectkick-off to project close
• Assisted in the development of project budgets
• Managed and sourced third party vendors
